authorized: disconnect and non-computer cold-power acceptance test

preconditions.cold_start_before_measurement_session: cold power cycle at the device end and confirm 194f:0422 / bcdDevice 0x0128 before measurement
preconditions.deterministic_audio_rig@batch: same-path positive control must pass at batch open and close; a mismatch makes every row in that batch INCONCLUSIVE

stop_recovery.bootloader_194f_0405: stop all work; cold power cycle at the device end, wait about 15 seconds, and confirm kernel USB disconnect; DFU reports Upload Unsupported and is never a repair path

catalog_reconcile.guard: catalog evidence authorizes no device write
catalog_reconcile.oracle: exact source address/table and one unambiguous operational or exclusion disposition
catalog_reconcile.sequence: identify table/model, recover omitted fields, map or classify duplicates/read-only entries

component_reconcile.guard: no descriptor ID is treated as a wire ID without an independently decoded bridge
component_reconcile.oracle: exact UC 4.7.2 component path, flags, type/range, runtime binding and io24 applicability
component_reconcile.sequence: map declaration to exactly one operational row or one evidence-backed exclusion

dsp_audio_enum.guard: selector/model write occurs before state; no stale-model parameters are sent
dsp_audio_enum.oracle: each member has its predeclared, mutually discriminating audio signature
dsp_audio_enum.restoration: restore prior member/state and require baseline equivalence
dsp_audio_enum.sequence: randomized member order with bypass between members

dsp_audio_scalar.guard: other physical channel delta <= 0.25 dB and target peak below -6 dBFS
dsp_audio_scalar.oracle: measured response matches the exact serialized coefficient/payload prediction
dsp_audio_scalar.restoration: replay exact inverse payload and require baseline equivalence
dsp_audio_scalar.sequence: randomized bypass/value/bypass brackets at safe low, nominal, high and clamp points

dsp_audio_toggle.guard: positive control passes and other channel stays within 0.25 dB of baseline
dsp_audio_toggle.oracle: objective transfer-function or dynamics change matches the selected block
dsp_audio_toggle.restoration: restore captured/bypass state and require baseline equivalence
dsp_audio_toggle.sequence: bypass/on/bypass with a discriminating fixed stimulus

front_panel_write_only.guard: never select a channel into the other channel's slot pair
front_panel_write_only.oracle: front-panel indication and resulting safe readable transitions agree with the mode
front_panel_write_only.sequence: command each declared mode, exercise the physical button, restore

host_mapping.guard: no hidden USB write from synchronization or page construction
host_mapping.oracle: exact downstream calls/state, silent programmatic adoption, and expected live result
host_mapping.restoration: restore Host state and downstream controls
host_mapping.sequence: instrumented fake -> local process -> live objective confirmation when audio-affecting

host_process.guard: no unrelated PipeWire/ALSA owner is stopped or reconfigured
host_process.oracle: process identity, requested live state, clean exit, and no orphan
host_process.restoration: clear forced setting and stop only the test-owned process

implementation_gap.guard: no guessed coefficients or unknown/unmapped device write
implementation_gap.oracle: cannot pass while absent, guessed, silently dropped, or represented by the wrong model
implementation_gap.restoration: defined by the eventual operational profile
implementation_gap.sequence: prove applicability -> implement exact binding -> run the appropriate live profile

mixer_assignment.guard: all other source/bus cells remain isolated
mixer_assignment.oracle: unassign reaches off sentinel; reassign returns the retained level within 0.35 dB
mixer_assignment.restoration: restore prior assignment and level, or park off

mixer_level.clamp_oracle: an out-of-range request must reach its clamped wire bound (-144.0 dB low or +10.0 dB high); -144.0 remains measurable and is not the -145.0 off sentinel
mixer_level.guard: Mix A appears only on USB 3-4; Mix B only on USB 5-6; no feedback path
mixer_level.oracle: captured level tracks requested delta within 0.35 dB and only on the selected bus
mixer_level.restoration: restore known prior level/assignment or park the route off

persistence.guard: only Channel 2 global slot 3 is overwritten; Channel 1 slot bodies and global slot 0 untouched
persistence.oracle: distinctive Fat Channel/effect signature is audible with no Host write in the observation window
persistence.restoration: restore selectors/enables/routing; slot-3 overwrite remains explicitly documented
persistence.sequence: save -> dislodge -> recall with Host closed -> disconnect -> non-computer cold power -> recall

readback_enum.guard: no unexplained cross-channel slot or processing displacement; a declared expected_side_effect is not a violation
readback_enum.oracle: exact integer readback of the selector; selector readback is not evidence that stored content was recalled into the audio path
readback_enum.restoration: restore captured member and prove exact readback, including reversal of any declared side effect
readback_enum.sequence: visit each safe declared member, then captured member

readback_scalar.guard: non-target readable state unchanged; audio remains below -6 dBFS
readback_scalar.oracle: exact integer/bit, or expected float32/declared device quantization
readback_scalar.restoration: restore the captured readable value and prove it read back
readback_scalar.sequence: baseline -> low -> nominal -> high -> low-clamp -> high-clamp -> baseline

readback_toggle.guard: other channel and unrelated flag bits unchanged
readback_toggle.oracle: exact JaSt bit/value plus the declared front-panel indication when one exists
readback_toggle.restoration: restore captured state and prove exact bit/value

serializer.guard: hardware-free; malformed/non-finite input is rejected before transport
serializer.oracle: byte-exact framing, float32 arithmetic, ordering, clamping, and inverse fixture

telemetry.guard: read-only path emits zero control writes
telemetry.oracle: reported value follows the independently measured stimulus with correct channel mapping
telemetry.restoration: remove stimulus; no state write required
telemetry.sequence: known negative control -> known positive control -> negative control

write_only_audio_scalar.guard: same-path positive control passes; target peak below -6 dBFS; other bus/channel isolated
write_only_audio_scalar.oracle: predeclared objective level, spectrum, timing, or transfer-function metric
write_only_audio_scalar.restoration: send the captured inverse and require baseline audio equivalence
write_only_audio_scalar.sequence: randomized A/B/A brackets at low, nominal, high and clamp boundaries

write_only_audio_toggle.guard: same-path positive control and non-target isolation both pass
write_only_audio_toggle.oracle: predeclared objective signal-domain difference; USB completion is insufficient
write_only_audio_toggle.restoration: return to captured state and require baseline audio equivalence
write_only_audio_toggle.sequence: A(off)/B(on)/A(off), with labels concealed from offline analysis
